description: A hidden transfer is resolved through what its receiver was declared as, never through a narrowing of it. A closure writes the `let` and a call writes the property, and the checker keeps both narrowings across the write anyway, so each of the four read forms meets the `Risky` getter the declaration really admits. The `const` keeps its narrowing, since nothing can write one.

diagnostics.message: Reading `o.p` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `p`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the getter `p` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
